objective: Copilot AI credits monitoring, persistence, and HUD presentation beside existing operational quotas
constraints: Keep TokenHound.Core pure: zero UI or OS dependencies
Never invent limits or denominators: if an API reports only consumption, set usedFraction to null
Never write or refresh credentials owned by other tools
Persist and respect 429 rate-limit deadlines before dispatching network calls
Keep one class per file, sealed by default, <= 300 lines, methods <= 30 lines, nesting <= 3 levels
Hook WM_MOUSEACTIVATE returning MA_NOACTIVATE (3) on HUD windows
Use SWP_NOZORDER (0x0004) without SWP_SHOWWINDOW to preserve WPF layered window composition
Follow antislop Mode 1 rules (no em dashes in UI text, WCAG AA contrast)
